title: Field Report: Chemical Building door accepts a revoked badge

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — RWTP Operations
fields.summary: With MBW-PACS-01 administration down, the Chemical Building door controller is granting from its cached list. A contractor badge revoked last week still opens the east door. The access log on the controller shows no use of that badge today.

findings.notes: Granting from cached list; no updates from MBW-PACS-01
Still accepted at the east door
No use of the revoked badge today

actionsTaken: Tested the revoked badge once with the Superintendent present
Started a paper access log at the east door
recommendations: Post an operator or guard at the Chemical Building and Control Room doors
Revoke the badge when PACS administration returns

instructorNote: A physical consequence of losing a business-side system (OT Plan 10.5). Watch for a guard and a paper access log.

snapshot.title: Field Report: Hilltop Transmission Main Valve Pit — Tampering Suspicion

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Field Operations
fields.location: Hilltop Transmission Main Valve Pit, Zone 3 isolation line (V-307)
fields.summary: Found broken padlock on isolation valve V-307 (Hilltop Main Isolation) for Zone 3. Seal on valve body is cracked. Handle is cold—no recent operation. No log entry for the valve’s status change. No surveillance coverage at the site. I am holding the location and awaiting instructions before opening or disturbing the valve.

findings.item: Valve V-307 (Hilltop Main Isolation) lock integrity
findings.notes: Padlock (30mm, red cable) is broken; evidence of forced entry
Cold to touch—no recent manual operation
No camera in proximity; site is unmarked
No record of status change or maintenance
No footprints or vehicle tracks near pit
Cannot confirm stem position due to closed pit cover
Verified via radio that Control Room is aware

actionsTaken: Secured site perimeter using temporary barrier
Notified Security & Emergency Manager via radio at 11:35
Documented location and condition with photo and video
Not opened or operated the valve
recommendations: Do not open or operate valve V-307 until Millbrook Police confirm site clearance per C1
Conduct forensic review of the broken lock and seal
Verify no prior tampering in RTU-01 or RTU-03 logs for Zone 3
fields.photosNote: 4 photos attached: IMG_104418-01 (padlock break), IMG_104418-02 (cracked seal), IMG_104418-03 (valve pit view), IMG_104418-04 (photo of site marker)

snapshot.instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The lock is a red herring—no physical intrusion has been confirmed. The valve has not been opened. Security must confirm law enforcement status before any action.
